engine: defaultSession(batchCooking, meal, existing) + sessionDates(weekStart) — edge _shared/vana/plan-math.ts / opener.ts · prototype server/vana/plan.ts (defaultSession only; no sessionDates — D-12)
note: `existing` lists only the sessions already assigned in the plan (order as stored). sessionDates vectors run on the edge twin only.

vectors.why: Batch cooking off → every meal is made the night of (session null).
Library meals tagged batch=true cook on the Sunday session.
Once Sunday holds ≥ 2 batch meals the next one becomes the Wednesday top-up.
Only cook-sun rows count toward the Sunday cap.
There is no Wednesday cap — every batch meal after the second lands on topup-wed.
A meal the catalog says does not batch is made fresh Friday, whatever Sunday holds.
Same rule; the Sunday count is irrelevant to a non-batch meal.
Weeks start on Sunday (env.weekStartFor); cook-sun = weekStart, topup-wed = +3, fresh-fri = +5.
